digest.component_or_area: completion verifier context assembly and file prefetching
propositions: Completion verifier requests waste 84-158 round-trips per run because file contents are discovered agentively; 67-82% of reads are already declared in file_impact union but fetched repeatedly.

Prefetch file_impact contents into the verifier context upfront: append a bounded, labelled prefetched-content section to the assembled fenced ticket_context with files ranked, skeletonized if oversize, and manifested.

Close gate (graph=False) prefetches only the closing ticket's own file_impact; deep-review (graph=True) prefetches the subtree union ranked by cross-descendant frequency; both sets bounded to 30k tokens aggregate with per-file 12k char cap.

Recovery successors receive the prefetch via the shared assembled ticket_context as a byte-stable block; prefetch bytes are included in physical_context_ceiling validation so oversized prefetch is trimmed rather than raising.

Trusted anti-anchoring guidance (confirm full bodies, re-read skeleton-marked files only) is co-located in completion_verifier.md static prefix BEFORE volatile marker so it is inherited by both primary and successor prompts.
Live A/B on real closed tickets demonstrates >=20% request-count reduction (f6fc 56%, e6a0 30%) with equal verdict class; clean request floor eliminates baseline over-exploration excursions.
